supersedes_only: The runtime-cost estimator and cross-account dispatch mechanism used by parallel_execution_plan_v1_2_1.json. Scientific experiment IDs, seeds, initializations, configs, checkpoint selection and analysis semantics are unchanged.

resource_envelope.process_model: one independent single-GPU child per slot

allowed_pre_science_measurements: steady-state wall seconds per optimizer step after subtracting checkpoint save/load time
validation forward end-to-end examples per second with labels/metrics unopened

forecast_contract.checkpoint_event_upper_bound_definition: floor(35820/250) periodic latest writes + 30 epoch-end latest writes + at most 30 selected-checkpoint writes
forecast_contract.purpose: Scheduling only. Forecast values are never model-selection evidence and do not change scientific training.

priority_freeze_algorithm.name: deterministic LPT list scheduling to six physical slots
priority_freeze_algorithm.state_cost: estimated_full_run_seconds_upper_bound from the sealed v1.2.2 profile qualification
priority_freeze_algorithm.job_order: descending estimated full-run seconds, then experiment_id ascending
priority_freeze_algorithm.assignment: assign each job in job_order to the physical slot with the currently smallest predicted cumulative load; equal-load ties use K1/GPU0, K1/GPU1, K2/GPU0, K2/GPU1, K3/GPU0, K3/GPU1
priority_freeze_algorithm.output: six immutable per-slot queues plus predicted cumulative slot loads
priority_freeze_algorithm.account_execution: K1 consumes only K1/GPU0 and K1/GPU1 queues; K2 consumes only K2 queues; K3 consumes only K3 queues. No mutable cross-account queue or race is required.

placement_and_recovery.checkpoint_scientific_identity: stable logical experiment lane independent of physical Kaggle account/GPU
placement_and_recovery.cross_slot_resume: authorized after exact durable-checkpoint identity/hash verification on another qualified T4
placement_and_recovery.migration_rule: a technical migration is an operational recovery action only; it may not change experiment ID, seed, initialization, configuration, selected-checkpoint rule or post-training analysis
